name: Saddle sUSD metapool stale MetaSwapUtils library
summary: The sUSDv2 metapool was linked to a stale MetaSwapUtils whose _calculateSwap path omitted baseVirtualPrice scaling when saddleUSD-V2 was the input or output token. Repeated sUSD/saddleUSD-V2 round trips therefore shifted the invariant and price curve in the attacker's favor until both sides of the metapool were drained.
notes: This direct MetaSwap deployment hard-linked the stale MetaSwapUtils library at 0x88cc4aa0dd6cf126b00c012dda9f6f4fd9388b17; the link is immutable in the pool runtime.

The receipt's transfer deltas show the metapool losing exactly 5,288,082.139740971886935251 sUSD and 5,016,537.096730963109713838 saddleUSD-V2. The latter is burned in the same transaction for 1,810,723.455638732389504479 DAI, 1,691,981.791323 USDC, and 1,530,488.975938 USDT, establishing an exact stablecoin-par value of $5,033,194.222899732389504479 without double counting those redemption assets.
